'''Seymarti V''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Seymarti system/Legends|Seymarti system]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] destroyed the planet in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="HAT">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref>
